Third-party code shipped unmodified:
  snapdom.js          @zumer/snapdom 3.3.3  — MIT, see snapdom.LICENSE.txt
  jspdf.umd.min.js    jsPDF 2.5.1           — MIT, see jspdf.LICENSE.txt
Fonts load from Google Fonts at runtime (IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Sans Arabic, Source Serif 4, Noto Naskh Arabic — OFL).
Thmanyah fonts are NOT shipped; the site only detects a locally installed copy.
